id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

modelFiles.description:
Map of urls of saved model files
key - model file name, value - {@link Url} corresponding to model file name

customModelCode.description:
A map containing {Module Name: Compressed Source Code} key-value pairs. The module name is the name of the
module from where the source code was taken from. (i.e. numpy).

processFunc.description: Name for the function on the native model to call to do {@link MlProcessable#process}.

underlyingPipe.description:
A pipe that contains the native model and implements {@link MlAtomicPipe#doProcess} and optionally
{@link MlAtomicPipe#doTrain}. If set, the implementation of the APIs on the `MlAtomicPipe` interface will be
dispatched through the underlying pipe. Otherwise, the developer has an additional responsibility to implement the
APIs.
DEVELOPER NOTE: If sub-types of {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe} is designed to have `underlyingPipe`, it is required to
override {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe#hasUnderlyingPipe} and return `True`

imageColumnName.description: The name of the column containing the urls of the images to be processed.

augmenters.description:
A list of {@link DiagramAugmenter}s to be used, such as {@link DiagramRandomCropper}. This field is required
if the user wants to train the pipe using {@link train}.

imgSize.description:
Inference size (pixels)
An original image (with essential padding) would be split into multiple (possibly overlapped patches).
The size of each image patch is (imgSize, imgSize).
Larger values generally result in more accurate but slower detections.

overlapRatio.description:
Overlap ratio of two adjacent tiles, 0 <= overlapRatio <= 1
The degree of overlap between adjacent tiles when splitting the input image for processing.
A higher value can improve detection but might increase processing time.

noTrace.description:
Don't trace model
If set to true, the model won't be traced during inference.
If set to false, a dynamic PyTorch model will be converted into a static TorchScript representation.
This conversion involves tracing the model's execution to capture its control flow and operations as a static computation graph.
Tracing can improve performance but might limit dynamic model behavior.

augment.description:
Augmented inference
If true, augmented inference techniques are applied during detection.
This means that the same data augmentation techniques are applied to the input image or patch during inference time. This results in multiple augmented versions of the input image.
Augmentation can improve detection robustness but may also increase computation time.

confThres.description:
Object confidence threshold
The minimum confidence level required for an object to be detected.
Objects with confidence scores below this threshold will be disregarded.

iouThres.description:
IOU threshold for NMS
The Intersection over Union (IOU) threshold used for Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS).
A higher value can prevent multiple detections of the same object, but might also filter out some valid ones.

filteredClasses.description:
Filter by class: --class ['TAG'], or --class ['TAG', 'LMI']
An array of class indices to filter the detected objects.
If specified, only objects belonging to these classes will be included in the results.

agnosticNMS.description:
Class-agnostic NMS
If set to true, class information is not considered during NMS, and only spatial overlap is used for filtering detections.
If set to false, for each class detected by the model, NMS is used to remove redundant bounding boxes within that class.
As a result, each class may have multiple detections, but within each class, duplicate detections are suppressed.

device.description:
Cuda device, i.e. 0 or 0,1,2,3 or cpu
Specifies the CUDA device to be used for inference.
You can set it to a specific GPU device (e.g., "0" or "0,1,2,3") or "cpu" for CPU inference.

targets.description:
Target symbols that the detector can detect
A list of symbols or classes that the object detector is trained to recognize.
Detection will be limited to these specified targets.

pth.description:
Trained pytorch state_dict file
The file containing the trained PyTorch model's state dictionary.
This file is necessary for loading the pre-trained model.

yaml.description:
Yaml model file
The YAML file containing the model's configuration.
It provides information about the network architecture, hyperparameters, and class labels.

title: This type represents an {@link MlPipe} template for YOLOv7 symbol detection in diagrams.
name: YoloSymbolDetectionPipe
